assumptions.description: All 128 rows are fully fictional values directly authored as literal CSV text via apply_patch. No fitted generator, sampling code, optimizer, calculator or programmatic rescaling was used to populate values. The task fixes the 38/46/19/25 stratum allocations.

I chose generally positive within-stratum BMI-urate co-ordering, with several crossovers and overlapping urate values. This direction and its resulting strength are discretionary construction choices, not relationships supplied by the source. Ages are manually mixed across these pairings; no age association, independence condition, correlation coefficient, conditional-mean formula or causal structure is asserted.

Within-group urate spread is assumed because the approved excerpt provides means but no urate SDs. The hand-authored ranges are 4.2-8.0 mg/dL for White males, 2.5-6.5 for White females, 4.3-8.1 for Black males and 2.7-6.5 for Black females. These are construction ranges, not empirical physiological limits, confidence limits or estimates of population dispersion. No urate distribution family or numerical SD was fitted or targeted.

The 20 screened U1 summaries guided the group centers and broad age/BMI spreads. Integer ages and one-decimal BMI/urate values are authoring conventions. Many BMI and urate entries were manually paired around group centers, introducing artificial symmetry and discreteness. No distribution family or tail shape is established by the source, and marginal resemblance cannot establish joint validity.

Age is in years, BMI in kg/m^2 and urate in mg/dL. Race and sex are retained solely as the task's published descriptive strata. The table is source-only fictional-data exploration, not participant evidence or a clinically validated cohort; it cannot support clinical confidence intervals, p-values, causal conclusions or validation claims. No adjustment or standardization was applied.

construction_route.derivation: Task-required direct literal table route. The supplied U1 excerpt supplies marginal guidance only; no scientific generator was estimated.

joint_structure.derivation: Author-selected ordering and manual row pairing; no admitted relationship estimate supports a sign or magnitude.

urate_dispersion.derivation: Author-selected literal ranges and spread around the supplied group means; the source packet contains no urate SD.
